name: wheelhouse-cli-repo
description: Repo tooling for the Wheelhouse CLI and Claude Code plugin

scripts.check: node --check cli/bin/wheelhouse.mjs && node --test cli/test/*.test.mjs >/dev/null && cmp -s cli/bin/wheelhouse.mjs plugin/scripts/wheelhouse.mjs && echo 'plugin copy in sync' && claude plugin validate ./plugin && claude plugin validate .
